```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
data_complete <- data[complete.cases(data[, c("Age", "sex", "Rx", "crp", "tlr",
                                               "tmb_braf", "OSwk", "Death",
                                               "PFSwk", "Progression")]), ]
```

```{r cramers-v-function, include=FALSE}
# Cramer's V function for binary variables
cramers_v <- function(x, y) {
  tab <- table(as.numeric(as.character(x)), as.numeric(as.character(y)))
  chi2 <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE))
  n <- sum(tab)
  k <- min(nrow(tab), ncol(tab))
  v <- sqrt(chi2$statistic / (n * (k - 1)))
  p_val <- chi2$p.value
  return(list(v = as.numeric(v), p = p_val))
}
```

```{r compute-correlations, include=FALSE}
biomarkers <- list(
  CRP = data_complete$crp,
  TLR = data_complete$tlr,
  `TMB/BRAF` = data_complete$tmb_braf
)

bm_names <- names(biomarkers)
n_bm <- length(bm_names)

# Correlation matrix
v_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_bm, ncol = n_bm,
                   dimnames = list(bm_names, bm_names))
p_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_bm, ncol = n_bm,
                   dimnames = list(bm_names, bm_names))

for (i in 1:n_bm) {
  for (j in 1:n_bm) {
    if (i == j) {
      v_matrix[i, j] <- 1.000
      p_matrix[i, j] <- NA
    } else {
      result <- cramers_v(biomarkers[[i]], biomarkers[[j]])
      v_matrix[i, j] <- result$v
      p_matrix[i, j] <- result$p
    }
  }
}

# Create display matrix with V values and significance stars
display_matrix <- matrix("", nrow = n_bm, ncol = n_bm,
                         dimnames = list(bm_names, bm_names))

for (i in 1:n_bm) {
  for (j in 1:n_bm) {
    if (i == j) {
      display_matrix[i, j] <- "1.000"
    } else {
      v_val <- sprintf("%.3f", v_matrix[i, j])
      p_val <- p_matrix[i, j]
      stars <- ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "***",
               ifelse(p_val < 0.01, "**",
               ifelse(p_val < 0.05, "*", "")))
      display_matrix[i, j] <- paste0(v_val, stars)
    }
  }
}

# Also compute prevalence for context
prevalence_df <- data.frame(
  Biomarker = bm_names,
  `N positive` = sapply(biomarkers, function(x) sum(as.numeric(as.character(x)) == 1)),
  `N total` = sapply(biomarkers, function(x) length(x)),
  Prevalence = sapply(biomarkers, function(x) {
    sprintf("%.1f%%", mean(as.numeric(as.character(x)) == 1) * 100)
  }),
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("Cramer's V matrix computed\n")
```

```{r display-prevalence}
kable(prevalence_df,
      caption = "Biomarker prevalence in the analysis population (n=65)",
      format = "html",
      row.names = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12)
```

```{r display-correlation}
kable(display_matrix,
      caption = "Table S2: Biomarker intercorrelations (Cramer's V)",
      format = "html") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "Cramer's V measures association between categorical variables (range 0-1).",
      "Significance levels: * p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001.",
      "CRP = C-reactive protein (<5 mg/L at week 4, before the first nivolumab dose); TLR = target lesion reduction (>=10%); TMB/BRAF = TMB >=9 mut/Mb or BRAF V600E.",
      "Weak intercorrelations (V=0.278 for CRP-TLR) limit confounding between biomarkers across model specifications."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) {
  dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Save both V matrix and p-value matrix
save_df <- as.data.frame(v_matrix)
save_df$Biomarker <- rownames(save_df)
save_df <- save_df[, c("Biomarker", bm_names)]

write.csv(save_df, file = here("tables", "table_s2.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Table saved to:", here("tables", "table_s2.csv"), "\n")
```

Table S2 has been saved to `tables/table_s2.csv`.
